title: Your body stays where you fell
summary: When you die on the train, a body in your skin and gear now lies where you fell, and the death scene's shots follow it. Dungeon Train now requires Sable: Ragdolls, which the CurseForge and Modrinth apps install for you.
highlights: A short death scene now plays before your recap, ending with a look up at the sky
The close shot and the carriage shot frame the body, wherever it tumbles
Your loot drops exactly as before; the body holds nothing and cannot be dragged
The body goes when you respawn
